messages:
Maya (Product): Heads-up — customer X wants a private onramp with staging + security rings. Need to align product/eng/runtime/infra/security on scope and gating. Who can own sequencing and what are the hard blockers?
Sam (Eng Runtime): I can drive runtime sequencing. Immediate items: pre-warm plan for model shards, pinned quantized variant for staging, KV cache warm-up strategy. Need rough capacity numbers from infra.
Priya (Infra): For private onramp we need VPC peering + subnet allocation and VPN for customer testing. Network request (internal ticket) typically 10 business days unless we pre-authorize. Also need service account approvals for staging.
Liam (Security): For security rings we require: threat model, dependency SCA, KMS/HSM integration plan, and audit retention policy. Pentest needs to be scheduled — earliest slot ~3 weeks out. Suggest dev -> staging -> canary -> prod rings with gating on findings.
Noah (Eng Platform): Observability checklist: tracing tags for request_id, model_version, route. Sampling config and rollout metrics (latency p50/p95, token cost, error rate). I want a short schema to wire our dashboards.
Maya (Product): Proposed launch criteria (minimum): 1) end-to-end customer flow validated in staging; 2) latency p50 < 200ms for canonical prompt set; 3) errors < 0.1% and no P0s in integration; 4) infra/network and security signoffs. Timeline aim: ~6 weeks from now.
Sam (Eng Runtime): For numbers: to hit p50 200ms in staging with quantized 7B we need 2 dedicated GPU pods (T4/A10-style) behind autoscaler with pre-warm policy. Also need KV cache migration window (couple of hours) — will coordinate with infra.
Priya (Infra): 2 pods + pre-warm is fine. Subnet/peering request: I'll open ticket today and flag for expedited review. VPN certs and service accounts take another week. If we compress approvals we might hit 4 weeks.
Liam (Security): I'll start the threat model doc now. Can someone drop the asset inventory and third-party list? Also confirm whether customer requires HSM-backed keys or managed KMS — that changes timeline.
Maya (Product): Customer said KMS with BYOK option ideally. I'll confirm HSM requirement by EOD. Asset inventory: @Noah can you export service list?
Noah (Eng Platform): I can export and add tracing/metric stubs. Will post a short doc in this thread by EOD.
Sam (Eng Runtime): QA question: how long for runtime integration tests and perf run? I need ~3 full days for perf runs + 2 days for regression if model variant is stable. Add another day for KV cache validation.
Maya (Product): Plan: 2 weeks QA (including customer integration window) + 1 week final fixes & security signoffs. That fits 6-week target if infra accelerates.
Priya (Infra): Okay I'll request expedited peering and service account approvals. If security needs pentest earlier, we may need to schedule external vendor slot — estimate 2-3k and 3 weeks.
Liam (Security): I'll try to carve an internal red-team pass in 1 week and then book external pentest. If HSM required, that's +2 weeks for KMS onboarding.
Maya (Product): Action items: 1) Sam to draft runtime rollout plan (due in 2 days). 2) Priya to open peering & VPN ticket (today). 3) Liam to start threat model + schedule pentest (this week). 4) Noah to export assets + observability schema (EOD). I'll confirm KMS/HSM requirement by EOD.
Sam (Eng Runtime): Got it. I'll post the rollout doc with pod sizing and pre-warm hooks.
Priya (Infra): Ticket opened #INF-4821, flagged for expedited review.
deploy-bot: New rollout plan created: rtp/1758205555-customerX-onramp (owner: Sam).
Maya (Product): Great — thanks everyone. If we can hit those deliverables this week we should be on track. :thumbsup:
Noah (Eng Platform): Added observability stub: https://go/internal/docs/obsv/customerX-stub — feedback welcome.
Liam (Security): Shared threat-model draft in thread. Please review before EOD.
Maya (Product): Closing the loop — next sync Friday 11am PT unless anyone needs earlier.
Sam (Eng Runtime): 👍
Priya (Infra): 👍
Noah (Eng Platform): 👍
Liam (Security): 👍
notes: thread focused on sequencing, owners, and gating criteria for a customer private onramp across product/eng/runtime/infra/security. Short messages, tickets and links included as expected in Slack.
